Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock launch gating for the new Telemetry UI. Customer asks pushed this to top of list from Acme + two pilots.
Ajit (Eng): Can you summarize the must-haves vs nice-to-haves? I want a minimal ship that doesn't explode our backend.
Maya (PM): Must-haves: 1) Latency + p50/p95 histograms per model route, 2) Error provenance links to traces, 3) Cost Breakdown panel (per-model, per-route), 4) Basic trace sampling hook that attaches request-id. Nice-to-have: live flamegraphs, anomaly alerts, query filters.
Lina (Eng): For (2) we need a lightweight pointer from error tile -> trace id. That means trace indexing with TTL or cold lookup. Cold lookups are fine for GA if we limit retention.
Drew (SRE): Retention tradeoff: 7 days indexed traces adds ~40% storage for our test workload. We can do 72h indexed + cold storage for 30d. That keeps SLOs and cost sane.
Samir (Data): For cost panel, we need token-count join with model config metadata (quantization flags). Right now token logs are per-instance; join latency is cheap if we batch enrich at ingestion. Could push the enriched stream to BigQuery nightly.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria proposal: - All must-haves implemented and e2e tested in staging, - Cost panel accuracy within 5% vs billing, - Trace linking works for 95% of errors in spot tests, - UX account admin toggle for trace retention.
Ajit (Eng): Question: do we gate on full trace sampling hook? Implementing a small header passthrough that tags traces with model name and route would be quick (~2 dev days). Full sampling engine integration is bigger. Suggest header passthrough first.
Lina (Eng): Agreed. Header passthrough + SRE ingestion rule to attach request metadata to traces. Then we can add sampling controls later.
Drew (SRE): Also: we should add a fail-open policy if trace store is unavailable so user reqs aren't dropped. (ops-bot: noted)
telemetry-bot: New alert rule created: telemetry.trace-ingest.error-rate > 1% for 15m -> paging oncall
Maya (PM): Can we commit to the minimal retention plan (72h indexed) for GA and a roadmap item to expand? Customers asked for 30d viewing but they accepted longer-term plan.
Samir (Data): For cost accuracy we need: per-token mapping, GPU time attribution, and rounding behavior. I can run a backfill comparison to billing exports and validate the 5% target.
Ajit (Eng): Implementation plan: phase 1 (GA minimal): UI panels, header passthrough, 72h indexed traces, nightly enrichment for cost panel. Phase 2: sampling controls, extended retention, anomaly alerts, per-customer configurable buckets.
Maya (PM): Timeline ask: GA in 6 weeks for pilot customers, 10 weeks for broader rollout. Any blockers?
Lina (Eng): Blocker: infra churn — eng-runtime needs a small change to propagate request-id to trace header for some legacy runtimes. I can do a spike but might need help from runtime team.
Drew (SRE): Also need canary plan for the new enrichment jobs. If we forget canary we risk spikes in ingress.
Ajit (Eng): I'll own the runtime change with Lina. We'll add feature flag and gradual rollout.
Maya (PM): OK. Action items: Ajit/Lina spike runtime header + PR by EOW, Samir run cost backfill and share delta by Wed, Drew produce retention/canary runbook and failure modes, UX to mock minimal Telemetry UI (I'll loop in design).
Samir (Data): FYI: Acme specifically asked for per-model latency histograms and per-tenant cost view. We should add a checkbox in the admin panel for tenant-level cost.
Maya (PM): Noted — add admin toggle to launch criteria.
Lina (Eng): One more: error tile -> trace should include a short stack snippet (if available) so UX shows 'error snippet' before full trace. Cheap win.
Ajit (Eng): Sounds good. I'll add a small proto to the error payload to include snippet when available.
Maya (PM): Great. If folks are OK I'll update the spec doc and raise a formal PR for launch criteria + roadmap. Reaction: :thumbsup: or :eyes: to indicate alignment.
Drew (SRE): :thumbsup:
Samir (Data): :eyes:
Lina (Eng): :thumbsup:
Ajit (Eng): :thumbsup:
Maya (PM): Thanks — I'll post the updated spec here when it's ready.
